legacy_inventory.local_acceptance_note: The 40 original source leads have final source-reference or disposition notes; batch target SK-41 has been added as a further maintained reference. Thirty-eight external official references are usable within recorded scope. Four local statutory transcriptions are accepted: Acts 71/1967, 404/2011, 365/2004 and 36/2005; 36 other lead records have no accepted local source-text copy. Thirty-one converted candidate texts and inputs remain in the Monitor archive; no topic or country completion is accepted.

policy: A human-reviewed official link is usable for ordinary research within the identified publisher, instrument, language, displayed date or cutoff, reviewed content, and limitations. Slov-Lex, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Interior are clearly identifiable official government sources. Use their government-published current or date-bound versions directly. No Gazette-fragment reconstruction, local capture, hash, replay, conversion, API access, or copying permission is required for link use. Check a later amendment only when it may materially affect the issue. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion. Local statutory transcription acceptance requires a verified official dated version, complete captured body, explicit authority caveat, and applicable reuse basis; link acceptance remains separate from local-copy acceptance.

sk_30.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic, Embassy in Hanoi
sk_30.version_or_cutoff: Page says published 2022-07-07; no later page revision date displayed. Reviewed against Slov-Lex Act 404/2011 version effective 2026-10-01.
sk_30.scope: Evidence of the information the Slovak Embassy in Hanoi published on 2022-07-07 about EU/EEA/Swiss-family entry and visa applications. Not accepted as current operational guidance.
sk_30.reviewed_content: The mission page lists categories of family members, identity/relationship/dependency evidence, and states that visa applications are free and processed within 10 working days. It cites Regulation (EC) No 562/2006, since repealed. Current Act 404/2011 §7(17) requires a valid travel document, family-link proof and dependency evidence where required, and gives a maximum decision period of 10 days. Directive 2004/38 Article 5(2) supports the no-visa-fee/accelerated-treatment statement for qualifying family members.
limitations: The page is dated 2022 and cites repealed Regulation (EC) No 562/2006; current Schengen Borders Code is Regulation (EU) 2016/399.
Its 10-working-day wording does not match current Act 404/2011 §7(17), which states 10 days. Do not rely on the mission page for the deadline.
No current Hanoi appointment channel, competent-mission determination, outsourcing arrangement or current checklist was established.
The page is a historical official page, not law, current operational guidance, a local source-text copy or topic coverage.

human_review_site_offers.site_name: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — Slovak diplomatic representations
human_review_site_offers.offer: Offer the official MZV mission directory and linked mission websites as a whole-site human review source for current visa and consular practice. The central pages and directory are usable as scoped official references, but local missions may set different checklists, appointments, submission channels, and outsourcing arrangements. Older pages found in the same official network are visibly stale and should not be treated as current rules.
human_review_site_offers.review_scope: For relevant applicant locations, identify the competent mission, current EU-family instructions, required documents, fee exemptions, appointment route, provider or outsourcing arrangement, and current forms. Record the page's date or version evidence and retain any inaccessible route as a human-review offer; do not infer that one mission's practice applies network-wide.
